about: Peer-edit scenarios of the acceptance target: edits to files of other agents during or between runs cause 0 re-executions and no failed run. Data only; scenario.py performs, render.py judges.

p1.about: unrelated peer edit: a root document and another product's source (outside the build closure), reverted 25 s later

p2.about: comment-only edit of a TS source inside the course closure, reverted 25 s later (one worker action is expected; the revert re-executes it too, see g32c-revert)

p3.about: comment-only edit of a scheduling leaf of the build tooling library (capacity consumption) while the build runs, reverted 25 s later; the run may restart itself (bounded) but must end green with 0 re-executions
